why: Task 5.3 guard table for contracts/governance/: one row per guard site, checked by scripts/ci/guards-table.js (its header says what each class means and what is checked).

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.constructor | _timeScale < 1 || _timeScale > 1440 | TimeScaleOutOfRange
sites.test: timeScale divides every voting period and delay; 1 is the mainnet schedule

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setProposalCreationCost | newCost == 0 || newCost > MAX_COST | CostOutOfRange
sites.test: the cost setters are the owner's and bounded (N69)

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setVotingCost | newCost == 0 || newCost > MAX_COST | CostOutOfRange
sites.test: rejects zero and anything above MAX_COST, accepts MAX_COST

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setMinVoterAge | newAge < lo || newAge > hi | VoterAgeOutOfRange
sites.test: is owner-only and bounded to [1 day, 30 days] / TIME_SCALE

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setDynamicListManager | _dynamicListManager == address(this) | GovernanceSelfBinding
sites.test: no row binds governance itself; no vote transfers governance (C-1)

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setDynamicListManager | _dynamicListManager != address(0) | Invalid address
sites.test: setDynamicListManager is the owner's and refuses zero (320-321)

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setEscrowWalletFactory | factory == address(this) | GovernanceSelfBinding
sites.test: no row binds governance itself; no vote transfers governance (C-1)

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setOnchainIDFactory | factory == address(this) | GovernanceSelfBinding
sites.test: no row binds governance itself; no vote transfers governance (C-1)

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setPrivacyManager | manager == address(this) | GovernanceSelfBinding
sites.test: no row binds governance itself; no vote transfers governance (C-1)

sites.site: GovernanceConfig.setZKVerifier | verifier == address(this) | GovernanceSelfBinding
sites.test: no row binds governance itself; no vote transfers governance (C-1)

sites.site: GovernanceConfig._requireHandedToGovernance | target.code.length > 0 | Target not handed to governance
sites.test: refuses to bind a factory not being handed to governance

sites.site: GovernanceConfig._requireHandedToGovernance | handed | Target not handed to governance
sites.test: refuses to bind a factory not being handed to governance

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.createProposal | expected == address(0) || target != expected | TargetNotBoundToType
sites.test: types 9 and 10 are unbound until a factory is handed over

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.createProposal | governanceToken.balanceOf(msg.sender) >= proposalCreationCost | Insufficient tokens for proposal creation
sites.test: Should fail to create proposal without sufficient tokens

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.createProposal | governanceToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), proposalCreationCost) | Token transfer failed
sites.reason: governanceToken is set once, in the constructor, to VGT (the ERC-3643 Token): no caller can name another token, and VGT.transferFrom returns true or reverts, never false.
sites.mutant: delete the require (call kept); suite green

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.castVote | proposal.status == ProposalStatus.Active | Proposal not active
sites.test: a vote on a cancelled proposal: Proposal not active (198)

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.castVote | block.timestamp <= proposal.votingEnds | Voting period ended
sites.test: a vote lands at votingEnds and is refused one second later (N62)

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.castVote | id != address(0) | Must be KYC/AML verified
sites.test: Should reject vote from unverified user

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.castVote | !_hasVoted[proposalId][id] | Already voted
sites.test: Should prevent double voting

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.castVote | id != proposal.proposerIdentity | Proposer cannot vote on own proposal
sites.test: excludes the proposer by identity, not by wallet

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.castVote | governanceToken.balanceOf(msg.sender) >= votingCost | Insufficient tokens for voting
sites.test: a verified holder short of the voting cost: Insufficient tokens for voting (210)

sites.site: GovernanceProposals.castVote | governanceToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), votingCost) | Token transfer failed
sites.reason: governanceToken is set once, in the constructor, to VGT (the ERC-3643 Token): no caller can name another token, and VGT.transferFrom returns true or reverts, never false.
sites.mutant: delete the require (call kept); suite green

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireEligible | identityRegistry.isVerified(wallet) | Must be KYC/AML verified
sites.test: Should reject proposal creation from unverified user

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireEligible | _controls(wallet, id) | Wallet does not control its identity
sites.test: refuses a wallet holding no key on its identity (ops re-binds Alice's identity)

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireEligible | registeredAt != 0 && registeredAt <= cutoff | Identity too new to vote
sites.test: swap-back: updateIdentity to an older identity cannot vote again

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireNotSelfTargeting | sel == SEL_TRANSFER_OWNERSHIP | GovernanceOwnershipByVote
sites.test: SystemParameters refuses transferOwnership of governance itself (D55)

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireNotSelfTargeting | (sel == this.setDynamicListManager.selector || sel == this.setEscrowWalletFactory.selector || sel == this.setOnchainIDFactory.selector || sel == this.setPrivacyManager.selector || sel == this.setZKVerifier.selector) && callData.length >= 36 && abi.decode(callData[4:36], (address)) == address(this) | GovernanceSelfBinding
sites.test: no row binds governance itself; no vote transfers governance (C-1)

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireAllowedSelector | callData.length >= 4 | Selector not allowed
sites.test: refuses renounceOwnership on every bound type and calldata under 4 bytes

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireAllowedSelector | sel != SEL_TRANSFER && sel != SEL_APPROVE && sel != SEL_TRANSFER_FROM && sel != SEL_RENOUNCE && sel != SEL_DISTRIBUTE && sel != SEL_BURN_SELF | Selector not allowed
sites.test: probe-b4: a VGT transfer of governance's deposits is refused at creation

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireAllowedSelector | sel == SEL_ADD_WHITELIST || sel == SEL_ADD_BLACKLIST || sel == SEL_REMOVE_WHITELIST || sel == SEL_REMOVE_BLACKLIST || sel == SEL_SET_ORACLES || sel == SEL_SET_GOVERNANCE || sel == SEL_SET_PROOF_EXPIRY || sel == SEL_TRANSFER_OWNERSHIP || sel == SEL_ACCEPT_OWNERSHIP | Selector not allowed
sites.test: ListUpdate accepts the list writes, the manager's owner surface and the ownership steps only

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireGovernedListManager | target.code.length > 0 | List manager not bound to governance
sites.test: a ListUpdate whose bound list manager has no code is refused

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireGovernedListManager | g == address(this) | List manager not bound to governance
sites.test: refuses ListUpdate on a manager bound to another governance, or unset

sites.site: GovernanceProposals._requireGovernedListManager | catch | List manager not bound to governance
sites.test: refuses ListUpdate retargeted at a contract with no governanceContract()

sites.site: GovernanceToken.delegate | delegatee != address(0) | Cannot delegate to zero address
sites.test: Should not allow delegation to zero address

sites.site: GovernanceToken.delegate | delegatee != msg.sender | Cannot delegate to self
sites.test: Should not allow delegation to self

sites.site: GovernanceToken.distributeGovernanceTokens | recipients.length == amounts.length | Arrays length mismatch
sites.test: distributeGovernanceTokens refuses arrays of different lengths

sites.site: GovernanceToken.distributeGovernanceTokens | recipients[i] != address(0) | Invalid recipient
sites.test: distributeGovernanceTokens refuses a zero recipient and a zero amount

sites.site: GovernanceToken.distributeGovernanceTokens | amounts[i] > 0 | Amount must be greater than 0
sites.test: distributeGovernanceTokens refuses a zero recipient and a zero amount

sites.site: GovernanceToken.distributeGovernanceTokens | transfer(recipients[i], amounts[i]) | Transfer failed
sites.reason: A call to the token's own transfer (no external address): Token.transfer returns true or reverts, never false.
sites.mutant: delete the require (call kept); suite green

sites.site: GovernanceToken._checkAgentTarget | !_compliance.isTrustedContract(target) | GovernanceToken: trusted contract
sites.test: ops cannot freeze, partially freeze, burn or recover governance

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.constructor | _governanceToken != address(0) | VanguardGovernance: Governance token is zero address
sites.test: the VanguardGovernance constructor refuses a zero or codeless token or registry

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.constructor | _governanceToken.code.length > 0 | VanguardGovernance: Governance token is not a contract
sites.test: the VanguardGovernance constructor refuses a zero or codeless token or registry

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.constructor | _identityRegistry != address(0) | VanguardGovernance: Identity registry is zero address
sites.test: the VanguardGovernance constructor refuses a zero or codeless token or registry

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.constructor | _identityRegistry.code.length > 0 | VanguardGovernance: Identity registry is not a contract
sites.test: the VanguardGovernance constructor refuses a zero or codeless token or registry

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.executeProposal | proposal.status == ProposalStatus.Active | Proposal not active
sites.test: is terminal: cannot be executed or cancelled afterwards

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.executeProposal | block.timestamp > proposal.votingEnds | Voting period not ended
sites.test: Should fail to execute before voting period ends

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.executeProposal | block.timestamp >= proposal.executionTime | Execution delay not met
sites.test: Should fail to execute before execution delay

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.executeProposal | gasleft() >= MIN_EXECUTION_GAS | Insufficient gas for execution
sites.test: P2: no gas limit settles a passed proposal as Rejected; it stays Active

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.executeProposal | gasleft() <= gasBefore / 63 | InsufficientExecutionGas
sites.test: L-1: a 35-wallet batch under-gassed above the floor reverts and stays Active

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.claimRefund | status == ProposalStatus.Rejected || status == ProposalStatus.Cancelled | Proposal not settled
sites.test: claim is once, only after settlement, and never on a passed proposal

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.claimRefund | amount > 0 | Nothing to claim
sites.test: cannot be refunded twice via a later execute or a second claim

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.claimRefund | _controls(msg.sender, id) | Wallet does not control its identity
sites.test: a bound wallet that no longer controls its identity cannot claim

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.claimRefund | governanceToken.transfer(msg.sender, amount) | Refund transfer failed
sites.reason: governanceToken is set once, in the constructor, to VGT: no caller can name another token, and VGT.transfer returns true or reverts, never false.
sites.mutant: delete the require (call kept); suite green

sites.site: VanguardGovernance.cancelProposal | proposal.status == ProposalStatus.Active || proposal.status == ProposalStatus.Pending | Cannot cancel proposal
sites.test: is terminal: cannot be executed or cancelled afterwards
